tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Input Tax Credit of ₹7,30,91,589/- (CGST + SGST) has been demanded to be recovered under Section 73(1) of the CGST Act, 2017, read with the corresponding provisions of the Delhi GST Act, 2017 and Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017, along with interest applicable under section 50 and penalty of ₹73,09,159/- imposed under Sections 73 and 73(9) of the CGST Act, 2017, and an additional general penalty of ₹50,000/- (₹25,000/- each under CGST and SGST) imposed under Section 125 of the CGST Act, 2017, read with the concurrent provisions of the Delhi GST Act, 2017 and Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017. The demand pertains to a GST matter relating to Input Tax Credit (ITC) availed on IPO-related expenses incurred during FY 2021–22, in connection with the Company’s listing pursuant to an Offer for Sale (OFS). The Company is of the view that it has strong legal and factual grounds to contest the findings of the adjudicating authority. The Company is also of the opinion that it has duly discharged its applicable GST liabilities in accordance with the law, and the matter primarily involves issues of legal interpretation. The Order was not final and was appealable under the provisions of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Additional Commissioner of Central Goods & Service Tax, Delhi South Commissionerate, New Delhi.
tax_litigation.status: The Company took a legal opinion and filed appeal with appellate authority
